name: Purplish Blue
lede: Purplish Blue is a vivid violet-blue, the standard-spelling twin of [[purpleish-blue]] from the same 2010 xkcd color survey.

sections.title: The standard spelling of a compound
sections.body:
The survey recorded both "purplish" and "purpleish" as separate entries over the same base colors, so this name and [[purpleish-blue]] are near-duplicates, 4.9 units apart [1]. No earlier dictionary or dye name is documented for either; 2010 is the only source on file [1]. The ISCC-NBS system would class it a vivid violet, 10.4 units off [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[burple]], 3.1 units away and duller [2]. [[light-royal-blue]] sits almost the same shade, and [[violet]] is close as well, at 3.9 units [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive matches this color across even a small share of its canvas, as photographed [3]. Its chroma is high enough that a close match on an aged, varnished canvas would be unusual [3]. The absence describes this archive, not painting generally [3].
